01-22-1553 is January 22, 1553.  
38 weeks = 38 × 7 = 266 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 268 days.  
1553 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, Gregorian calendar not adopted yet, but we treat as proleptic Gregorian).  
Jan 22 + 9 days → Jan 31 (22+9=31).  
Remaining 268 − 9 = 259 days.  
Jan has 31 days, so after Jan 31:  
Feb (28 days) → 259 − 28 = 231 left.  
Mar (31) → 200 left.  
Apr (30) → 170 left.  
May (31) → 139 left.  
Jun (30) → 109 left.  
Jul (31) → 78 left.  
Aug (31) → 47 left.  
Sep (30) → 17 left.  
Oct 17 days → October 17, 1553.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1553-10-17
